{{Quote|I am Ceetoo Deefour, former translator to Her Imminence, Queen Lina of Onderon; and this is my current master, the renowned illicit-transport specialist Jakarro.|C2-D4|<ref name="Depths">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=tactical|Depths of Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''royal court of Onderon''', also known as the '''Onderonian court''', was a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchal]] court of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="Codex Jakarro" /> During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C2-D4]] served [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]]'s<ref name="Depths" /> royal court as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]], though he later left the court's service and became the partner of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jakarro]].<ref name="Codex C2-D4">{{TORcite|type=codex|C2-D4}}</ref>
